title: Extract packs_marketplace.go from packs.go
description:
## What
Create `core/controlplane/gateway/packs_marketplace.go` by moving all marketplace-related types, handlers, and functions OUT of `packs.go`. Do this AFTER packs_validate.go is extracted.

## Exact items to move

### Marketplace Type Definitions (lines 314-405)
- `marketplaceCatalogConfig` (lines 314-316)
- `marketplaceCatalog` (lines 318-323)
- `marketplaceCatalogFile` (lines 325-328)
- `marketplaceCatalogPack` (lines 330-345)
- `marketplaceCatalogStatus` (lines 347-354)
- `marketplacePackItem` (lines 356-376)
- `marketplaceResponse` (lines 378-383)
- `marketplaceCache` (lines 385-388)

### Marketplace Constants & Vars

- Marketplace env constants: `envMarketplaceAllowHTTP`, `envMarketplaceHTTPTimeout` (lines 47-48)

### Marketplace HTTP Handlers

- `(s *server).handleMarketplaceInstall` (lines 476-610)

### Marketplace Internal Functions

- `compareVersions` (lines 1191-1226)
- `normalizeVersion` (lines 1228-1232)
- `parseVersion` (lines 1234-1255)
- `downloadPackBundle` (lines 1257-1297)
- `validateMarketplaceURL` (lines 1299-1331)
- `marketplaceHTTPTimeout` (lines 1333-1340)
- `marketplaceHTTPClient` (lines 1342-1361)
- `hostFromURL` (lines 1363-1373)
- `(s *server).marketplaceAllowedHosts` (lines 1375-1411)

## How
1. Create `packs_marketplace.go` with `package gateway`
2. Add imports: `context`, `crypto/tls`, `encoding/json`, `errors`, `fmt`, `io`, `log/slog`, `net/http`, `net/url`, `os`, `strconv`, `strings`, `sync`, `time`, plus project imports
3. Move all listed items
4. Remove from packs.go
5. Run `go build ./cmd/cordum-api-gateway`

## Notes
- Use function NAMES to locate items (line numbers from original packs.go before any extractions)
- The marketplace types (lines 314-405) are a contiguous block
- The marketplace functions (lines 937-1411) are another contiguous block
- After extraction, packs.go should be ~1400 lines
